content:
The fastest animal depends on the context:

1. On land:
- Cheetah (up to 70 mph / 112 km/h)

2. In air:
- Peregrine Falcon (diving speed up to 240 mph / 386 km/h)

3. In water:
- Sailfish (up to 68 mph / 109 km/h)

The cheetah is typically considered the fastest land animal in terms of sustained speed, while the peregrine falcon is the fastest animal overall when diving.
